hooks.command: flag="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.commit-authorized"; prompt=$(jq -r '.prompt // ""'); if printf '%s' "$prompt" | grep -qiE '\b(commit|push)\b'; then date +%s > "$flag"; else rm -f "$flag"; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|()])[[:space:]]*git([[:space:]]+-C[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)?[[:space:]]+(commit|push|reset|rebase|revert|cherry-pick|filter-branch|stash[[:space:]]+drop|branch[[:space:]]+-[dD]|tag[[:space:]]+-d)\b'; then flag="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.commit-authorized"; now=$(date +%s); ts=$(cat "$flag" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); age=$(( now - ts )); if [ -f "$flag" ] && [ "$age" -le 600 ]; then rm -f "$flag"; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "allow", "permissionDecisionReason": "commit/push found verbatim in the current user message (mechanically checked, not by the agent)."}}'; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "No commit/push instruction detected in the current user message. Say commit or push explicitly, or run it yourself."}}'; fi; fi
